answer: Latency triangulation: each epoch a beacon pulse has five random validators ping every identity at once and log round-trip times. Keys whose timing vectors match within 2 ms are treated as one machine behind a bridge and split a single reward. Keeping 1,000 keys distinct means renting 1,000 hosts in separate cities, roughly $5,000 a month, to earn ~3 POA per passing answer. Keys copy freely, but light-speed delay is as stubborn as basalt.
